description: Funds $36,392.50 for roof replacement at 304 3rd Avenue North.
Grant paid over three years for heritage property repairs.
Repairs address storm damage to prevent further deterioration.

chips.text: Approved
Total project cost for the damaged roof section is $85,000.
Committee balanced heritage considerations with practical and financial constraints.
Third Avenue United Church receives funding for roof repairs.

description: Committee reviewed the draft 2026 annual report.

chips.text: Approved
Final expenditures for the annual report are still being compiled.

description: Final budget reconciliation for expenditures is pending.

description: Chair provided update on Heritage Saskatoon 50th anniversary.

chips.text: Received as information

description: Saskatoon stores heritage artifacts from demolished buildings.
These include stone, brick, and Capital Theatre elements.
Students cataloged items to encourage public reuse.
City seeks strategies to increase awareness and use.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor urged quick action to preserve Capital Theatre memory.
Marred residents are reusing cobblestones in a community garden.
Who is responsible for creating a plan for Capital Theatre assets?
More reporting on artifact reuse policy expected in the next year.

description: Bowerman House heritage windows replaced due to water damage.
New aluminum windows emulate original wood frame design.

chips.text: Approved
Finding windows to match Bowerman House heritage dimensions was difficult.
YWCA manages the city-owned Bowerman House heritage property.
Staff will provide pictures of the completed window replacement project.
